name: baseline
description: WHD Next firewall baseline. Offline, native, editable. Ships SAFE: default-deny outbound is OFF until you flip it. IPv6 suppressed (loopback ::1 preserved). DNS pinned to Cloudflare malware-filtering resolver 1.1.1.2/1.0.0.2 over encrypted DoH (menu D); HTTP/HTTPS open to Any = 'practical strict'. Block lists are NOT included: an IP list is used only if you put your own profiles\blacklist-ip.txt there (Firewall 9, or F with files in profiles\incoming). Apply via WHD.ps1 firewall menu (A) or Invoke-WHDApplyFirewallProfile.

allowList.name: WHDN-Allow-DHCP-Out
allowList.displayName: WHD Next Allow DHCP request (UDP out 68->67)

allowList.name: WHDN-Allow-DHCP-In
allowList.displayName: WHD Next Allow DHCP reply (UDP in <-67)

_notes: Practical strict: set defaultDenyOutbound to true to block all outbound except this allow-list. HTTP/HTTPS stay open to Any so browsing + Windows Update keep working; DNS is pinned to Cloudflare 1.1.1.2/1.0.0.2 (malware filter).
To change resolver: edit the two DNS remoteAddress arrays here AND $script:WHDDnsServers + $script:WHDDohTemplate in modules\Firewall.ps1 (templates for 1.1.1.1 / 1.1.1.2 / 1.1.1.3 are listed there).

Block lists are NOT included. An IP list is used only if you put your own profiles\blacklist-ip.txt there (Firewall 9, or F with files in profiles\incoming); without that file WHD Next logs a warning and adds no block rules. The engine safety-guards every entry and skips any broadcast/multicast/private/reserved range, so a bad list can't break DHCP/LAN.

DOMAIN blocking is done at the resolver, not a host sinkhole: menu D sets Cloudflare 1.1.1.2 (malware) + encrypted DoH. Change to 1.1.1.3 for malware+adult. The hosts sinkhole (menu H) needs your own profiles\blacklist-hosts.txt and is NOT applied by this baseline.
When defaultDenyOutbound is true, an auto-rollback task reverts outbound to Allow after rollbackMinutes unless you run Confirm-WHDDefaultDenyKeep.
For MAX strict (allow-listed destinations only), remove the HTTP/HTTPS entries and add explicit destination allow rules with remoteAddress.
